Detailed Description

template<class T> class CCfits::ColumnData

Templated concrete Column subclass representing columns with scalar row entries.

ColumnData<T> has a data member of type std::vector<T> of size HDU::rows() holding the data entries. It implements all scalar columns, as used in FITS Ascii Tables, and also implements Binary Table columns with string arrays as row entries.

custom constructor.

This one is used either for reading or writing. Since the Factory method ColumnCreator has to get other information from the file to know what type of ColumnData to construct, that information is just fed back to the constructor instead of having a smaller parameter list and getting the constructor to determine everything from either the column index or the column name

See Column class for details of the arguments

const std::vector< T > & data ( ) const [inline]
 

return a const reference to the data in the column.

The use of this is that a user should be able to write, e.g.

FITS = z2 FITS("data1.fits","r","FIRSTTABLE",true);

to read all the data in HDU FIRSTTABLE in the file data.fits

and then write

std::vector<float>& x = z2.extension("FIRSTTABLE").column("DATACOL").data();

to gain a reference for the data in column DATACOL, after which the data in that column can be used through the reference x.
